picks._doc: the picture chosen of each element (its seed), from the contact sheets of 2026-11-02

style: hand-drawn fantasy map art in sepia ink with faded watercolour washes, as drawn on an old parchment map
backdrop: alone on a plain pure white background, soft even light from the front

styles.texture: a flat even texture filling the whole picture edge to edge, with no frame, no border and nothing drawn on it
styles.icon: a small stylised map symbol seen from above at a slight angle, the whole symbol inside the picture with a wide empty white margin all around it, a fine dark ink outline

elements.name: map_papyrus
elements.prompt: an old sheet of papyrus seen straight on, warm cream and light ochre fibres woven across each other, faint stains and darker blotches, softly worn, the same all over

elements.name: mapicon_castle
elements.prompt: a grim stone castle keep with four square towers and a dark arched gate, wisps of grey mist curling out of its gate

elements.name: mapicon_smithy
elements.prompt: a small stone smithy with a tall chimney breathing a curl of smoke, an iron anvil standing before its open front

elements.name: mapicon_store
elements.prompt: a small timber-framed shop with a striped awning over its front and crates and sacks of goods stacked beside its door

elements.name: mapicon_healer
elements.prompt: a small cottage with a bundle of green herbs hanging over its door and a stone basin of clear water beside it

elements.name: mapicon_temple
elements.prompt: a stone temple with tall columns and a domed roof crowned by a golden sun disc

elements.name: mapicon_storehouse
elements.prompt: a long wooden storehouse barn with wide double doors and an iron-bound chest standing before them

elements.name: mapicon_circle
elements.prompt: a ring of standing stones around a softly glowing blue rune circle drawn on the ground

elements.name: mapicon_board
elements.prompt: a wooden notice board on two posts with pinned parchment notes and a small roof over it

elements.name: mapicon_tavern
elements.prompt: a cosy two-storey timber tavern with a hanging sign shaped like a tankard and a lit window

elements.name: mapicon_home
elements.prompt: a small thatched cottage with a single chimney and a little garden fence

elements.name: mapicon_burned
elements.prompt: the blackened ruin of a burned cottage, charred broken beams and a collapsed roof, a thin trail of smoke

elements.name: mapicon_boarded
elements.prompt: a small abandoned cottage with wooden planks nailed in a cross over its door and windows

elements.name: mapicon_chapel
elements.prompt: a small stone chapel with a pointed bell tower and a single bell

elements.name: mapicon_graveyard
elements.prompt: a small graveyard with rows of crooked headstones inside a low iron fence and a bare tree

elements.name: mapicon_barracks
elements.prompt: a long low stone barracks with crossed spears and a pennant flag on a pole before it

elements.name: mapicon_market
elements.prompt: three small market stalls with coloured cloth canopies around baskets of fruit

elements.name: mapicon_well
elements.prompt: a round stone well with a little wooden roof and a hanging bucket

elements.name: mapicon_still
elements.prompt: a copper still with a round pot, a coiled pipe and wooden barrels beside it

elements.name: mapicon_mill
elements.prompt: a wooden windmill with four large sails on a stone base

elements.name: mapicon_tower
elements.prompt: a single square stone watchtower with crenellations on top and a small flag

elements.name: mapicon_gate
elements.prompt: a heavy closed wooden town gate between two stone gate towers, barred with an iron bar

elements.name: mapicon_square
elements.prompt: a cobbled town square with a small stone fountain in its middle

elements.name: mapicon_witch
elements.prompt: a crooked little hut with a bubbling cauldron before it and bundles of dried herbs and a raven on its roof

elements.name: mapicon_you
elements.prompt: a red wax seal arrowhead pointing upward, flat and simple
